tickets.title: Process one-time $38,000 IRA distribution for remodel deposit
tickets.text: Process a $38,000 gross one-time distribution from Dorian Pebblefizz's traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to the Teacup Comet Bank checking account to fund the first contractor deposit for the home accessibility remodel covering first-floor bathroom and entryway changes.
tickets.evidence: Dorian asked for a $38,000 gross distribution from the traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to be sent to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit, and they agreed to complete the one-time IRA withdrawal by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Change recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Confirm the requested recurring payment change, verify the effective timing with the provider or custodian, and document the old and new payment method or amount without storing unnecessary sensitive details. Adjust Dorian Pebblefizz's recurring traditional IRA distribution at Velvet Acorn Custody from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month, update the bank destination to Teacup Comet Bank checking, and document the revised withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle.
tickets.evidence: Dorian also asked to raise the regular IRA cash flow from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month and to document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle; they agreed to complete the recurring IRA distribution adjustment by 2025-08-20.

tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when a client reports a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications. Update records for Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz following their June 2025 move from Portland, Oregon, to Henderson, Nevada, including advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing for Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz's June 2025 move from Portland, Oregon, to Henderson, Nevada.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields for the Pebblefizz household.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements for the Pebblefizz household.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers to Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz.

tickets.evidence: The move from Oregon to Nevada requires advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions to be updated using the new residency facts Dorian provided, and they agreed to complete those updates by 2025-08-22.

tickets.title: Resolve Oregon state withholding on IRA distributions
tickets.text: Resolve the Oregon state withholding discrepancy on Dorian Pebblefizz's recurring traditional IRA distribution at Velvet Acorn Custody, which still shows Oregon withholding despite the household's June 2025 move to Henderson, Nevada, and update the withholding to reflect Nevada residency for future payments.
tickets.evidence: The custodian record still shows Oregon state withholding on the recurring IRA distribution even though Dorian described the Henderson home as the current primary residence and did not expect Oregon withholding on future payments;

tickets.title: Check IRA payment timing and bank instruction history
tickets.text: Review the payment timing and bank instruction history for Dorian Pebblefizz's IRA ACH deposits to Teacup Comet Bank checking, following a recent late deposit that required manual transfer from savings to cover household bills.
tickets.evidence: Dorian reported that a recent IRA ACH deposit reached Teacup Comet Bank later than expected and caused him to move money manually from savings to cover household bills. They agreed that the payment timing and bank instruction history need to be checked by 2025-08-18.

tickets.title: Year-End Deadline Sweep
tickets.text: Complete the year-end distribution and tax planning deadline review for Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz, incorporating the higher IRA withdrawals, possible Portland sale proceeds (approximately $410,000 net), and Elena's expected 2025 wages of about $28,000 from Clockwork Clover School, in coordination with CPA Tobin Mossbutton of Amber Teapot Tax Services before final estimated tax planning.

tickets.title: Request and organize estate document copies
tickets.text: Ask the client to provide current copies of core estate documents, including will, revocable trust if applicable, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designations, trustee or executor contact information, and any recent amendment pages. Store received documents according to firm procedures and note missing items for follow-up. Collect current wills, powers of attorney, trust amendment pages if applicable, and beneficiary confirmations from Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz for recordkeeping and planning review, as only older 2018 estate papers are currently available in the advisory file.
tickets.evidence: Because only older estate papers are available in the advisory file, they agreed that current wills, powers of attorney, trust amendment pages if applicable, and beneficiary confirmations need to be collected for recordkeeping and planning review by 2025-09-05.

tickets.title: Compare cash-raising options for Pebblefizz household
tickets.text: Compare IRA distributions, taxable cash, and selective sales for the Pebblefizz household's cash-raising plan without assuming the Paper Otter Components employer stock in the joint taxable account at Velvet Acorn Custody is the first funding source, reviewing tax impact and concentration risk together.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review noted a large Paper Otter Components position in the joint taxable account, so they agreed that the cash-raising plan should compare IRA distributions, taxable cash, and selective sales without assuming the employer stock is the first funding source, with the review due by 2025-09-12.
